annotation.bound_parties_text: The Communication is a policy action plan that sets out planned Commission actions and calls on Member States and co-legislators, but imposes no binding obligations on any party.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Commission will inform the European Parliament and the Council about this Action Plan and the actions proposed and calls on them to enable a swift implementation of targeted amendments proposed.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: starting with allowing the approval of unlimited series of vehicles with automated parking systems in 2025 and more use cases (e.g. hub-to-hub freight transport) in 2026
